knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Suitable suction and a vented or ducted design limit dust release. The other options spread dust or misuse the vacuum.
The guide requires cleaning between clients using the manufacturer method. The other options fail to clean the item or delay the clean.
Fumes from chemicals or spillages are one of the hazards the guide lists. The other options are not hazards in the guide list.

practicalCriteria: Given a vacuum with a full bag, the learner closes and replaces the bag without spilling and checks the filter.
Given a shared item such as a walking frame, the learner cleans it between clients using the manufacturer method and approved product.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Assessor observation of the vacuum bag change and filter check
Assessor observation of the shared-item clean on a simulated item
stopWorkCriteria: Dust is being released from a vacuum that is damaged or overfilled: stop, switch off and report.
A product is not listed for the item: stop and check with the supervisor.
Chemical fumes or a skin reaction occur: stop, ventilate if possible, and report.
